artworks.description: The image shows an architectural structure viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is near the top of the image, where the sky meets the decorative building and tall columns with intricate carvings. The artwork appears to be an etching or engraving, with fine lines and detailed patterns. The color palette is primarily shades of gray, emphasizing the line work, light, and shadow. People and animals are depicted among rocky terrain around the structure. Ships with sails are docked nearby. The background features detailed clouds.
